stem: Zara uses a stopwatch in PE to record a relay split of 150 seconds. She also writes times in minutes and hours in her notebook.

parts.text: Which claim about time units is correct?

options.text: The SI unit of time is the second; 150 s = 2.5 min.
The SI unit of time is the minute; 150 s = 2.5 min.
1 h = 120 s, so 150 s is more than one hour.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: The SI unit is the second, and 60 s = 1 min, so 150 s = 2.5 min.

teacher.key_rationale: SI unit of time is the second; 60 s = 1 min so 150 s = 2.5 min. B misnames the SI unit; C and D misuse the hour–second and hour–minute relations.
